_comment: The ordered tab sequence of a guided `full` run, as drupilot 0.9.0 declares it (captured from the v0.9.0 tag): each command's `choice.sh --key KEY` calls in document order, plus the tabs declared only by an AskUserQuestion header (a key of config/choices.json with no choice.sh call, such as PUSH, which is never pre-answered) or, in a command, by a `"<header>" tab` it shows (drupilot-refactor.md reuses the port's Drupal 10 check tab, so D10_CHECK appears in both stages). Conditional tabs appear only when their condition fires. New tabs may only be inserted (CC-02); `auto` shows none.
